Private Function Grid(ByVal ws As Worksheet) As String
    Dim c As Range, s As String
    For Each c In ws.Range("A2:B6")
        s = s & "|" & c.Formula
    Next
    Grid = Mid(s, 2)
End Function

Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Range("A1:B6").Value = Application.Transpose(Application.Transpose(Array(Array("h1", "h2"), Array(3, "c"), Array(1, "a"), Array(5, "E"), Array(2, "b"), Array(4, "e"))))
    ws.Range("A1:B6").AutoFilter
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        ws.AutoFilter.Sort.SortFields.Add ws.Range("A2:A6")
        Tried = ws.AutoFilter.Sort.SortFields.Count & " " & ws.Sort.SortFields.Count
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\added.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 1
        ws.Sort.SortFields.Add ws.Range("A2:A6")
        Tried = ws.AutoFilter.Sort.SortFields.Count & " " & ws.Sort.SortFields.Count
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\sheet.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 2
        ws.AutoFilter.Sort.SortFields.Add ws.Range("A2:A6")
        ws.AutoFilter.Sort.Apply
        Tried = Grid(ws)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\applied.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 3
        ws.AutoFilter.Sort.SortFields.Add ws.Range("B2:B6"), , xlDescending
        ws.AutoFilter.Sort.Apply
        Tried = Grid(ws) & " " & ws.AutoFilter.Sort.Rng.Address & " " & ws.Sort.SortFields.Count
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\down.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 4
        ws.AutoFilter.Sort.SortFields.Add ws.Range("B2:B6")
        ws.AutoFilter.Sort.MatchCase = True
        ws.AutoFilter.Sort.Apply
        Tried = Grid(ws)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\case.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 5
        ws.AutoFilter.Sort.SortFields.Add ws.Range("A2:A6")
        ws.AutoFilter.Sort.Apply
        ws.AutoFilter.Sort.SortFields.Add ws.Range("B2:B6")
        Tried = ws.AutoFilter.Sort.SortFields.Count
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\later.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 6
        ws.AutoFilter.Sort.SetRange ws.Range("A1:B3")
        Tried = ws.AutoFilter.Sort.Rng.Address
    Case 7
        Tried = ws.AutoFilter.Sort.Header
    Case 8
        ws.AutoFilter.Sort.Header = xlNo
        Tried = ws.AutoFilter.Sort.Header
    Case 9
        ws.AutoFilter.Sort.MatchCase = True
        Tried = ws.AutoFilter.Sort.MatchCase & " " & ws.Sort.MatchCase
    Case 10
        ws.AutoFilter.Sort.SortFields.Add ws.Range("A2:A6")
        ws.AutoFilter.ShowAllData
        Tried = ws.AutoFilter.Sort.SortFields.Count
    Case 11
        ws.AutoFilter.Sort.SortFields.Add ws.Range("A2:A6")
        ws.AutoFilterMode = False
        ws.Range("A1:B6").AutoFilter
        Tried = ws.AutoFilter.Sort.SortFields.Count
    Case 12
        Tried = TypeName(ws.AutoFilter.Sort) & " " & TypeName(ws.AutoFilter.Sort.Parent) & " " & TypeName(ws.AutoFilter.Sort.SortFields)
    Case 13
        ws.AutoFilter.Sort.SortFields.Add ws.Range("A2:A6")
        Tried = ws.AutoFilter.Sort.SortFields(1).Key.Address
    Case 14
        ws.AutoFilter.Sort.SortFields.Add ws.Range("D2:D6")
        ws.AutoFilter.Sort.Apply
        Tried = Grid(ws)
    Case 15
        ws.AutoFilter.Sort.Apply
        Tried = Grid(ws)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\empty.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    End Select
Done:
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Done
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim s As String, i As Long
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 15
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
